title: aquilegia pyrenaica f. confusa
intro: Aquilegia pyrenaica f. confusa, commonly known as Pyrenean columbine, is a variety of flowering plant within the aquilegia genus. As a plant with potential medicinal properties, it is used to treat various health issues such as inflammation, pain, and gastrointestinal problems. The health benefits of Aquilegia pyrenaica f. confusa include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids, saponins, and phenolic compounds.
